title: NGS Library Prep Part 1: PCR Setup I
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add mastermix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 15 µL of mastermix from the first column of the reagent plate into every well of the PCR plate using the same set of tips.

steps.title: Transfer samples to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Aspirate 10 µL of each sample from the sample plate and dispense into the corresponding PCR‑plate well containing the pre‑added mastermix, using a fresh tip for each sample.
